workRoots.description: Git toplevels under any prefix are "work" mode. The first entry is also the parent of the sh-devctl repo: the /validate gate resolves its scripts as <workRoot>/sh-devctl/scripts.

items.description: Absolute path prefix of a work repo root

avenWorkspace.description: Aven workspace name or key forced on every aven call pi-flow makes (skips cwd inference and the search fallback).

landTestCommand.description: Argv of the test command flow_land runs before authorizing a landing (default ["bun","run","test"]). PMR-05HX: the landing gate never trusts a claimed-green suite.
